name: American Gold Eagle
weight: 1 troy oz gold — 33.93 g total weight
description: The American Gold Eagle is the official U.S. gold bullion coin, first issued in 1986. It features Augustus Saint-Gaudens’ classic Lady Liberty design on the obverse and an American eagle design on the reverse. Made from 22K gold for added durability, it is one of the most recognized and widely traded gold coins in the United States.
